certificate.chain.empty: The uploaded file is readable but holds no certificate.
certificate.chain.incomplete: The chain stops at issuer '{issuer}', which is not in the file. Clients that do not already hold that issuer will refuse the handshake.
certificate.chain.too_long: The uploaded file holds {certificate_count} certificates, and a chain holds at most {limit}.
certificate.chain.unreadable: The uploaded certificate is not readable as PEM.
certificate.expired: The uploaded certificate expired on {not_after_unix}. It is stored, but it will not be accepted by any client.
certificate.expiring_soon: Certificate '{certificate}' expires on {not_after_unix}, in {remaining_seconds} seconds. An uploaded certificate is never renewed automatically.
certificate.key.mismatch: The uploaded private key does not belong to the uploaded certificate.
certificate.key.passphrase_required: The uploaded private key is encrypted. Enter its passphrase.
certificate.key.passphrase_wrong: The passphrase does not open the uploaded private key.
certificate.key.unreadable: The uploaded private key is not readable as PEM.
config.acme.directory_url_invalid: The ACME directory address must be an HTTPS address.
config.acme.missing: Certificate '{certificate}' is obtained through ACME, but no ACME server is configured.
config.acme.no_http01_listener: Certificate '{certificate}' uses HTTP-01 validation, but no plaintext HTTP frontend listens on port {port}. The ACME server asks for the challenge on that port only.
config.acme.terms_not_accepted: No certificate can be ordered until the ACME server's terms of service are accepted.
config.acme.wildcard_needs_dns01: Certificate '{certificate}' covers a wildcard name, which is only issued against DNS-01 validation. Point it at a DNS provider.
config.backend.cookie_stickiness_on_udp: Backend pool '{backend}' uses cookie based session stickiness, but frontend '{frontend}' carries UDP.
config.backend.stickiness_cookie_name_in: The stickiness cookie name of backend pool '{backend}' carries a character a cookie name cannot hold.
config.certificate.in_use: Certificate '{certificate}' is still offered by {frontend_count} frontend(s) and cannot be removed.
config.certificate.unknown_dns_provider: Certificate '{certificate}' names DNS provider '{provider}', which is not defined.
config.dns_provider.api_base_invalid: DNS provider '{provider}' has an API address that is not an HTTPS address. The API token would leave this machine in the clear.
config.dns_provider.propagation_timeout_: DNS provider '{provider}' is given no time to publish its challenge record. Set a timeout in seconds.
config.duplicate_id: The same {kind} identity is defined more than once: '{id}'.
config.frontend.access_log_sample_zero: Frontend {frontend} has its access log on with a sample rate of zero, so no record is ever written. Set the rate to 1 for a record per request, or turn the access log off.
config.frontend.certificate_expired: Frontend '{frontend}' offers certificate '{certificate}', which expired on {not_after_unix}. Every handshake that picks it fails.
config.frontend.duplicate_binding: Port {port} on '{vip}' is already taken by frontend '{conflicting_frontend}'.
config.frontend.redirect_without_http: Frontend '{frontend}' has a redirect rule but does not speak HTTP, so it cannot answer one.
config.frontend.sni_rules_without_passth: Frontend '{frontend}' carries {rule_count} SNI rule(s) but does not pass TLS through, so nothing ever reads a ClientHello to match them against.
config.frontend.tls_on_passthrough: Frontend '{frontend}' passes TLS through, so it never opens the handshake and never presents a certificate. Set its application to HTTP to terminate TLS instead.
config.frontend.tls_without_http: Frontend '{frontend}' carries TLS settings but does not speak HTTP.
config.frontend.unknown_backend: Frontend '{frontend}' names backend '{backend}', which is not defined.
config.frontend.unknown_certificate: Frontend '{frontend}' names certificate '{certificate}', which is not defined.
config.frontend.unknown_default_certific: The default certificate '{certificate}' of frontend '{frontend}' is not among the certificates that frontend offers.
config.frontend.unknown_vip: Frontend '{frontend}' names VIP '{vip}', which is not defined.
config.frontend.unreachable_routing_rule: Routing rule {rule} of frontend '{frontend}' can never match, because rule {earlier} already takes every request it would take.
config.health_check.timeout_above_interv: The health check timeout of backend pool '{backend}' ({timeout_ms} ms) is longer than its interval ({interval_ms} ms).
config.port.out_of_range: {port} is not a valid port number.
config.stickiness_key.missing: Cookie based session stickiness is turned on, but no signing key of at least {shortest_bytes} bytes is configured.
config.vip.in_use: VIP '{vip}' is used by {frontend_count} frontends and cannot be removed.
config.vip.too_many: The cluster defines {vip_count} VIPs, but one network segment holds at most {limit} virtual router ids.
config.vip.unknown_preferred_node: VIP '{vip}' prefers node '{node}', which is not defined.
